d:
Nothando Hlophe singing "Mmeli Wami" from Spirit Of Praise 12. Recorded live at Sunbet Arena, Tshwane.
Lyrics:
Isizathu sokukhala asisekho (the reason for weeping is gone)
Izinyembezi nobuhlungu buphelile (the tears and pain are over)
Uye wang’mela ebunzimeni (He stood by me in times of trouble)
Ngonyama (The Lion)
Mmeli Wami (my defender)
Uyewangmel'ebunzimeni (You have stood by me in times of trouble)
